content: goreleaser: reads .goreleaser.yml, builds for goos/goarch matrix (linux/darwin/windows, amd64/arm64), generates checksums, creates GitHub Release. GitHub Actions workflow: trigger on tag push, goreleaser/goreleaser-action, needs GITHUB_TOKEN with contents:write. CGO_ENABLED=0 avoids cross-compilation toolchain requirement. Test locally with goreleaser release --snapshot --clean.
